metadata.description: Codex CLI plugins by xiaolai — ports of the Claude Code marketplace

plugins.name: grill
plugins.description: Deep codebase interrogation — multi-angle architecture review with 7 specialized analysis skills, 5 review styles (including Paranoid Mode), and 8 add-on pressure tests

plugins.name: eou-foundry
plugins.description: Recursive governance for Executable Operating Units (EOUs). Faceted classification, generating-EOU constraints, ECP-governed change, no-self-approval. v0.7.0: Stage 0 (captured_workflow + domain_values constitutional layer + Rule 96). v0.8.0: agentic judgment (judgment_authorized flag, value_invocations trace, F14–F17 taxonomy, $audit-judgment skill, Rule 97, counterfactual-swap audit).

plugins.name: nlpm
plugins.description: Natural-Language Programming reference knowledge as Codex skills — the 50 Rules, the 100-point scoring rubric, per-tool conventions (Claude Code / Codex CLI / Antigravity), anti-patterns, vocabulary discipline, and authoring guides. Knowledge skills, not commands: load $nlpm-rules + $nlpm-scoring to score an artifact, $nlpm-conventions-codex for the Codex skill layout. The interactive /nlpm:* linting commands remain a Claude Code plugin; cross-tool deterministic checks use the standalone bin/nlpm-check.
